name: Exaltation
overview: Scripture reveals that exaltation is fundamentally about the supreme honor and authority given to Christ, who is both God and the Word from the beginning (John 1:1). God has highly exalted Jesus, giving Him a name above every name (Philippians 2:9), affirming His unique role as the way to the Father (John 14:6) and the appointed heir of all things (Hebrews 1:2). In contrast, any attempt to exalt self or preach a gospel contrary to the true message of Christ is condemned (Galatians 1:8), underscoring that true exaltation belongs solely to Christ alone.
